ROSAnT-ng is a nuclear fluorescent reporter with the following features: (1) it can be used for in situ lineage tracing; (2) it can be combined with a nuclear reporter of Cre expression; (3) it can be applied to any cell or tissue type; and (4) it allows the analysis of ploidy transitions in cell populations.
